scope: 四种箭矢大像素块重画；该记录不修改Unity引用、PPU或Pivot。
recipeNotes: 4箭均无羽毛；木箭仅木棒，石/铜/铁箭为木棒+对应头材料。原始生成PNG未缩图、未限色。

assets.name: 木箭
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent, single-frame inventory/projectile arrow sprite for FlatWorld.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the EXISTING arrow for identity and its mandatory orientation: tail at LOWER LEFT, point at UPPER RIGHT, exactly about +45 degrees. Preserve this arrow's long slender structure. Image 2 is the user-approved new bronze AXE solely for COARSE PIXEL BLOCK SIZE and large connected shading; DO NOT draw an axe. Image 3 (approved current bear) and Image 4 (native 32x48 player) reinforce the same chunky low logical resolution; do not draw animals or people.
CRITICAL STYLE: true big-block retro pixel art drawn on a very coarse logical grid, as if the entire arrow uses about 28 to 32 logical pixel steps along its long axis and is then hugely enlarged. The shaft, head, outline and nock use the SAME large square logical cells. Clear hard stair-stepped silhouette, sparse connected colors, one broad highlight and shadow, no fine texture inside the logical cells. A thin arrow shaft is at most one or two logical cells wide, with a small readable head at most about four or five logical cells across, not a spear or axe blade. Same lighting, proportions and framing across the four-arrow set.
Composition: exactly ONE complete long thin arrow, straight along the +45-degree diagonal from lower-left tail to upper-right point, centered with comfortable transparent padding. Full shaft, point and tail all visible. It has a warm muted brown wooden shaft with just a continuous large main-color stripe and dark underside; simple small cut nock at the rear. No separate stick or accessories.
Game recipe constraints: these are primitive UNFLETCHED arrows made from wood sticks and optional stone/copper/wrought-iron heads. There are NO FEATHERS in the recipe. Draw NO fletching, NO wings, NO tassels or plume at the tail. Do not add modern metal collars, screws or decorative fittings.
True transparent alpha background. No ground, shadow, UI, text, labels, border, arrows-as-diagram symbols, bow, quiver, multiple arrows or sprite sheet. Avoid high-definition pixel art, smooth gradients, dense scratches, individual wood fibres, shiny sparkles, fine bevel lines, antialiased edges, painted/high-resolution illustration with a pixelation filter. Paint the chunky sparse sprite directly.
Subject for THIS image: WOOD ARROW (Arrow_Wood). Its only material is WOOD: the front is the same shaft shaved to a sharp point. No attached stone or metal head, no lashing at the point, and absolutely no feathers at the tail. A few large warm-brown/ochre wooden color masses distinguish the pointed end without adding fine grain. The point faces upper-right. One wooden arrow only.
